data.current_summary: Import a CSV file of parcels
data.current_description:
Allows importing a CSV file containing parcel information, including sender details, recipient details, and parcel content. The CSV file must include the following columns:
- **reference** (string): order number / your internal reference of the parcel or order. (Required)
- **tracking_number** (string): Parcel tracking number. (Required)
- **carrier** (string): Carrier name. Possible values: "Chronopost", "Colissimo", "Colis Privé", "DHL", "DPD", "Fedex", "GLS", "Mondial Relay", "Relais Colis", "Royal Mail", "UPS", "USPS", "Evri", "DHL Express", "Other". (optional)
- **sending_mode** (string): Type of parcel/shipping mode (e.g., "Chrono 13", "Express"). (Optional)
- **tracking_link** (string): URL for tracking the parcel. (Optional)
- **estimate_delivery_date** (string): Estimated delivery date of the parcel. (Optional) ("MM/DD/YYYY")
- **parcel_value** (number): Value of the parcel. (Required)
- **parcel_weight** (number): Weight of the parcel in kg. (Optional)
- **parcel_currency** (string): Currency for the parcel value. (Optional)
- **parcel_category** (string): Parcel category. Possible values: "Jewelry & Watches", "Leather & Luggage", "Fashion & Accessories", "Art & Collectibles", "High Tech", "Furniture & Decor", "Food", "Household appliances", "TV Hifi", "Beauty & Cosmetic", "Sport & Outdoor", "Tools & Construction", "Music & Hobbies", "Liquids", "Other" (optional)
- **sender_company** (string): Sender's company. (Optional)
- **sender_first_name** (string): Sender's first name. (Optional)
- **sender_last_name** (string): Sender's last name. (Optional)
- **sender_address** (string): Sender's address. (Optional)
- **sender_zipcode** (string): Sender's postal code. (Optional)
- **sender_city** (string): Sender's city. (Optional)
- **sender_country** (string): Sender's country. (Optional)
- **recipient_company** (string): Recipient's company. (Optional)
- **recipient_first_name** (string): Recipient's first name. (Optional)
- **recipient_last_name** (string): Recipient's last name. (Optional)
- **recipient_address** (string): Recipient's address. (Optional)
- **recipient_zipcode** (string): Recipient's postal code. (Optional)
- **recipient_city** (string): Recipient's city. (Optional)
- **recipient_country** (string): Recipient's country. (Optional)
- **recipient_email** (string): Email of the recipient. (Optional)
- **recipient_lang** (string): Preferred language of the recipient. (Optional)
- **recipient_notif** (boolean): Whether the partner authorizes communication with the recipient ("Yes"/"No"). (Optional)
- **cart_data** (string): Custom field that can be displayed on the parcel data screen if relevant. (Optional)
- **payment_mode** (string): Payment method used. (Optional)
- **claimer_email** (string): Email of the claim manager if different from the one who subscribes. (Optional)

**Additional instructions:**
- The column headers must exactly match those listed above.
- Columns are mandatory in the CSV file, but values can be left empty.
- Values for **carrier** and **parcel_category** fields must be among the listed options. If an invalid value is provided, it will be replaced with "Other".
- The column separator must be a semicolon (`;`).
data.summary_suggestion: Bulk import parcels from CSV file
data.description_suggestion: Imports multiple parcels from a CSV file with semicolon separators. Required columns: reference, tracking_number, parcel_value. Optional columns include carrier, sender/recipient details, and parcel metadata. Invalid carrier or category values default to "Other". Returns import status with count of successfully created parcels and any validation errors. All imported parcels are registered in the system and associated with the API key.
